summary: GoPro filed an 8-K reporting the Third Closing under its February 27, 2026 securities purchase agreement with YA II PN, Ltd. (Yorkville), issuing a $20,000,000 convertible debenture, completing the up-to-$50,000,000 facility. Terms include a 3.00% original issue discount, maturity August 26, 2027, and no interest unless adjustment events trigger 5.00% or 18.00% rates. Conversion price is the lower of $1.35 or 98% of the five-day VWAP, subject to a stated floor. Board recommendation and advisors were not disclosed. The structure is dilutive financing rather than a special situation; watch conversion-driven overhang and the anti-dilution floor.
